Package org.lucas.models

Class Patient

java.lang.Object
org.lucas.models.User
org.lucas.models.Patient
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObjectBase
public class Patient extends User implements ObjectBase
Represents a patient in the healthcare system, extending the User class with medical-specific details. This class includes fields for managing a patient's medical history, allergies, date of birth, consent status, address, and next of kin information. It is used to maintain comprehensive patient records necessary for medical treatments and administrative purposes.

    • Patient

      public Patient(String userID, String userName, String name, String password, String email, String gender, String medicalHistory, String allergies, LocalDateTime dateOfBirth, String address, String nextOfKinName)
      Constructs a new Patient with specified personal and medical details.
      Parameters:
      userID - Unique identifier for the patient.
      userName - Patient's username for system access.
      name - Patient's full legal name.
      password - Patient's password for system access.
      email - Patient's email address.
      gender - Patient's gender.
      medicalHistory - Description of the patient's past medical conditions and treatments.
      allergies - Any known allergies that the patient has.
      dateOfBirth - The patient's date of birth.
      address - The residential address of the patient.
      nextOfKinName - The name of the patient's next of kin.
